name: 机械女声
description: robotize 配方：电话带通 300–3500Hz + 40Hz 环形调制 + 12bit 量化（比 Close 略柔）。
note: 用户 2026-10-11 生成于桌面 BSH-yushe；音频随预设存放，不入公开仓库。

sounds..Default: sounds/（默认应用通用事件）,Generic system event.wav
sounds.AppGPFault: sounds/程序崩溃（一般保护性错误）,Application error. The program has terminated.wav
sounds.ChangeTheme: sounds/切换主题,Theme has been changed.wav
sounds.CriticalBatteryAlarm: sounds/电池电量严重不足,Critical warning. Battery is very low. Connect power now.wav
sounds.DeviceFail: sounds/设备连接失败,Device connection failed.wav
sounds.LowBatteryAlarm: sounds/电池电量低,Warning. Battery level is low.wav
sounds.Notification.Default: sounds/通用通知,You have new information.wav
sounds.Notification.IM: sounds/即时消息,New message. Please respond.wav
sounds.SystemAsterisk: sounds/信息（星号）,Information. A new message has arrived.wav
sounds.SystemExclamation: sounds/警告（感叹号）,Warning. Please check your system.wav
sounds.SystemExit: sounds/退出 Windows,System shutdown. Save your work.wav
sounds.SystemHand: sounds/严重错误（停止）,Critical error. System halted. Save your work.wav
sounds.SystemQuestion: sounds/询问（问号）,Question. Your input is required.wav
sounds.WindowsLogoff: sounds/注销 Windows,Logging off. Session ending now.wav
sounds.WindowsLogon: sounds/登录 Windows,Welcome back. System is ready.wav
sounds.WindowsUAC: sounds/用户账户控制（UAC）,Permission required. Account control.wav
sounds.WindowsUnlock: sounds/解锁 Windows,System unlocked. Welcome back.wav
